Section 10 · Bridge, Stretch & Career Toolkit

Keep learning.
Make it your own.

Recommended, optional resources to strengthen course skills and build evidence for your career. Complete them during or after the course, at your own pace.

Free LinkedIn Learning with your NYU email. Sign in through NYU's LinkedIn Learning access to take these courses at no cost. Individual courses offer completion certificates. The Wolfram Research professional certificate requires the full learning path and final exam.

These resources are not required or graded and do not affect your course grade. Choose what serves your interests. You do not need to complete every option.

Turn learning into evidence

Build a small portfolio artifact

Use public or fictional data. State the business question, document data quality, choose an appropriate chart, and explain the result and its limits.

Explain the work

A certificate records completion. A clear, reproducible analysis shows what you can do. Add a short reflection on the choices you made and what you would investigate next.
